messages:
Zoe: Heads-up: I'll be in the London office next Wed morning (King's Cross). Any good breakfast spots open ~8:30am or quick lunch places nearby? Prefer something walkable for a team of ~4.
Priya: Try Granger & Co for breakfast 1037c373. They open early and have large tables. Also Caravan in Granary Sq for coffee + all-day brunch.
Tom: For quick lunch, St Pancras Market has loads of stalls and seating 357. Good if ppl want different cuisines.
Noor: Dishoom is popular but long queues; could do delivery. If you want pastries, Paul Bakery at the station opens early.
James: If anyone's vegan, "Mildreds" on Torrens St is a short cab away and great.
Zoe: Thanks 44d. Budget ~a320pp. Prefer sit-down but market stalls are fine. Any spot that can do a table for 4 without waiting ages?
Priya: Granger usually ok with a reservation at that time. Call ahead?
Tom: I can swing by at 8:15 and hold a table if you want 609. Otherwise St Pancras Market seating is first-come.
Noor: Quick list:
```
- Granger & Co (Granary Sq) - breakfast, reservations recommended
- Caravan (Granary) - coffee/brunch, casual
- St Pancras Market - many stalls, communal seating
- Paul Bakery (King's Cross) - pastries, opens early
- Dishoom (nearby) - great but queues
- Mildreds - vegan option, short taxi
```
Link: https://maps.app.goo.gl/kingcross-eats
CateringBot: Reminder: For office catering, submit orders at https://redwood.gig/catering 48h before. We can do mixed diets.
Zoe: Perfect 60a. I'll reserve Granger and ping the calendar. If anyone prefers market vibes, say now so I can skip the reservation.
James: Market is cool with me.
Priya: Granger works for me.
Tom: Granger it is 37d. See you there!
